name: c975l/payment-bundle
description: Symfony bundle providing the generic basket and checkout engine plus Stripe payments for the c975L ecosystem — any bundle plugs its own sellable items in through BasketItemProviderInterface.

suggest.c975l/shop-bundle: Plugs a product catalog into the basket - products, their items, their stock and their downloadable files become buyable through BasketItemProviderInterface
suggest.c975l/crowdfunding-bundle: Plugs crowdfunding counterparts into the same basket, a campaign being paid for through this bundle rather than through a checkout of its own

scripts.lizard-nloc: find src -name '*.php' ! -name '*CrudController.php' ! -name '*Type.php' | xargs lizard -l php -T nloc=99 -C 999 -a 999 -w

scripts-descriptions.audit-deps: Avis de sécurité Packagist sur les dépendances résolues (OWASP A06) - les paquets abandonnés sont signalés, sans faire échouer
scripts-descriptions.lizard: Complexité et longueur des méthodes de src/, aux paliers que Codacy applique (lizard)
scripts-descriptions.qa: Tous les contrôles de la CI, dans l'ordre - voir bin/ci.sh pour les rejouer sur des dépendances fraîches
